description: This PHP source file defines the MigrationRegistry class, which manages the tracking of migration execution statuses within a CRM system by interacting with a configuration database. It provides methods to check if a migration has already been run and to record migration completion, using database queries and logging.

classes.name: MigrationRegistry
classes.description: A class for tracking migration status by reading and writing to a configuration table in the database, ensuring idempotency and proper logging.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MigrationRegistry with database and logger managers.

methods.name: hasMigrationRun
methods.description: Checks whether a specific migration identified by migrationId has already been executed, returns true if it has, false otherwise.

methods.name: recordMigrationCompletion
methods.description: Records the completion of a migration in the config table with timestamp, logging the operation and handling errors.
